content: I took this opportunity to clean any residue off of the pulleys and make sure that they are spinning without any friction.
Also if you like details and the type markings on the belts to be upright (you're going to see those inside the printer) now is the time to check the orientation.

replies.content: I wouldn't have cared if you hadn't pointed it out, but now I'll forever be annoyed because I did make sure the bottom belt was upright, but forgot to check for the top belt, which is now upside down lol.

content: If you've touched the linear rails, guide rods or z leadscrews during the process, now is the time to degrease your hands. You woudn't want the belts to slip.
